title: receipt for one bug fix
caption:
itemized, for the client who asked why it took all afternoon.

reproducing it: 2.5 hours. 47 console.logs. 40 minutes blaming the cache.
the fix itself: one character, two minutes.
no refunds. it may come back.

what's the smallest fix that took you the longest?

slide.kicker: you pay for knowing which character
